blocks.title: Language editors
blocks.text: Language editors, jinhein code editors bhi kehte hain, woh tools hain jo developers ko mukhtalif programming languages mein code likhne aur badalne mein code likhne ka aasan interface de kar madad karte hain.

items: Notepad++: saada magar taqatwar code editor.
Sublime Text: apni tezi aur aasani ke liye mashhoor.
VS Code: bohat si extensions wala mashhoor editor.

blocks.prompt: Language editor ka maqsad kya hai? Do misalein dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Code likhne aur badalne ke liye aasan interface dena; misalein Notepad++, Sublime Text aur VS Code.

items: Language (code) editors: code likhne ke aasan tools; Notepad++, Sublime Text, VS Code.
